qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Utility generation assets and renewable energy development pipeline backed by long-term power purchase agreements (PPAs). However, renewable project development is a commoditized, highly competitive auction market where capital costs dictate bidding margins. 5-year median ROIC of 4.8% demonstrates lack of structural moat, and fixed PPA contracts lack pricing power above inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC = 4.8% < 12% hurdle, REJECT). Renewable power developer and independent power producer competing in commoditized PPA auctions. Multi-cycle ROIC of 4.8% is far below the 12% capital efficiency hurdle, burdened by heavy project leverage, execution risks, and lack of pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC is 4.8%, with 5-year average hovering near 4.1%. Project development model relies on commoditized competitive bidding for long-term PPAs against low-cost institutional capital, squeezing returns on invested capital. High corporate and non-recourse project-level debt further amplifies balance sheet vulnerability.
